report_name: CatalystFlow 队伍最终结果与分析
report_scope: 最终评测协议、公开数据范围、四项核心指标、优化性能与鲁棒性、DFT 选择后解释、轨迹审计、外部兼容性、智能体复现、已查询 Top-5 现实可行性评估与最终推荐反应条件

terminology.official_reproduction: 2 datasets x 20 fixed seeds x 40 sequential queries
terminology.queried_top5: five highest observed-yield unique conditions aggregated only from legal query records
terminology.final_recommended_reaction_condition: DeepSeek selection from non-blocked queried Top-5 after six-dimension feasibility assessment; optimizer_rank unchanged; no_condition_recommended if all five are blocked
terminology.surrogate_model: 以较低成本近似反应条件到产率关系的预测模型；本项目具体由随机森林和/或高斯过程实现，并向采集函数提供预测均值与不确定性
terminology.offline_oracle: 离线预言器（OfflineOracle）；仅在候选索引确定后返回该索引的一条产率，未查询候选产率不可用于特征、训练、调参或排序
terminology.AUC_best_so_far: 40 轮 best-so-far 序列的算术平均，不是 ROC-AUC
terminology.round_to_95_global_best: 首次达到候选池全局最高产率 95% 的轮数；40 轮内未达到时记为 41
terminology.feasibility_score_notation: 现实可行性总分完整范围为 6–18；若任一维度为 unknown，则总分显示为破折号。例如 —（4/6）表示六个维度中仅四个具备可评分信息，另外两个为 unknown；括号内为已评分维度数/总维度数。

critical_safety_flags: Triethylamine is flammable, acutely toxic and corrosive.

feasibility_assessment.evidence_boundary: Supplier catalog and SDS claims are verified only for the cited product, region and retrieval date. Target scale and location are absent, so budget and scale-up risk remain unknown; operation and waste statements remain low-confidence LLM inference.

evidence_retrieval.policy: external database and primary-source retrieval before LLM fallback
evidence_retrieval.llm_fallback: saved DeepSeek assessment retained only where qualifying evidence is absent

safety_boundary: The external evidence snapshot does not replace current China-region quotation, inventory, full-component SDS review, laboratory SOP, calorimetry, waste-vendor acceptance or EHS approval.

Suzuki.rationale: Rank 3 is the only non-blocked queried Top-5 condition after SDS review: it avoids the Self-heating Category 1 LiOtBu used in ranks 1, 2 and 4 and the higher-hazard triethylamine/acetonitrile combination in rank 5, while retaining 99.05 observed yield.
unresolved_information: Current SDS for every substrate and ligand
Concentration, addition order, calorimetry and waste-vendor acceptance
Suzuki.evidence_basis: verified supplier catalogs and SDS plus low-confidence LLM fallback

Buchwald_sub4.rationale: Rank 1 retains the highest observed yield; its tBuXPhos catalog price is materially below the retrieved AdBrettPhos price for rank 2, while all five candidates remain conditional because target-scale budget and scale-up evidence are unavailable.
unresolved_information: Target-scale China-region quotation for all components
Current SDS for every aryl halide, ligand and additive
Concentration, catalyst loading, calorimetry and waste-vendor acceptance
Buchwald_sub4.evidence_basis: verified supplier catalogs and MTBD SDS plus low-confidence LLM fallback

dft_post_interpretation.policy: computed project DFT first, external database or primary literature second, explicitly labelled LLM inference only when direct evidence is absent

Suzuki.supported_scope: general catalytic-cycle context for interpreting role-specific frontier-orbital and charge descriptors
Suzuki.limitation: the paper uses a model system and does not establish a causal yield effect for the submitted candidates

Buchwald_sub4.supported_scope: general steric/electronic ligand context for interpreting post-selection ligand descriptors
Buchwald_sub4.limitation: the paper studies a different substrate system and does not validate the submitted candidate ranking

dft_post_interpretation.computed_artifact_boundary: Only packaged ORCA artifacts determine computed values, coverage and status; external sources and DeepSeek provide post-selection interpretation only.
dft_post_interpretation.llm_fallback: Use explicitly labelled low- or medium-confidence inference only when no directly relevant registry or primary-literature source is available.

Suzuki.summary: Rank 3 exchanges 0.85 percentage points of observed yield for removal of the LiOtBu self-heating Category 1 flag and avoids the triethylamine/acetonitrile burden in rank 5.

Buchwald_sub4.summary: Rank 1 retains the highest observed yield and the retrieved tBuXPhos catalog price is substantially below AdBrettPhos for rank 2; all candidates remain conditional because scale, location, complete SDS and scale-up evidence are incomplete.

new_data_boundary.allowed: Use databases and DeepSeek to resolve identity, synonyms, structures, reaction family, variable roles and units; reviewed outcome-free structures and metadata may enter features.
new_data_boundary.forbidden: External or literature yields, activities, optimum conditions, unqueried candidate results and outcome-derived preferences may not enter fitting, tuning, prompting, EI or ranking.

required_checks: Confirm target scale, laboratory location and current SDS for every component.
Recheck supplier price, stock and delivery for the intended region and date.
Complete SOP, calorimetry or process-safety review and waste-vendor acceptance before execution.
Retry unavailable literature databases when network access is restored and retain direct records actually used.
